title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity fixes; bump v1.84.0
author: Aisha Rahman
description: Motivation: Unify authentication, retry logic, and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to reduce differences users hit when migrating examples between languages and to fix parity bugs introduced during v1.83.x maintenance. This PR bundles ergonomic changes, bug fixes, and a non-breaking surface change that improves defaults for retries and streaming cancellation. What this PR does (summary): - Standardizes token refresh flow and credential chaining across SDKs (supports static API keys, env-based credentials, and token refresh callbacks). - Introduces a single RetryPolicy abstraction (configurable max_attempts, backoff_base_ms, max_backoff_ms, retry_on_statuses) and aligns default behavior across SDKs. - Improves streaming client ergonomics: a unified event interface (chunk, delta, done, error) and a cancellable stream handle with context/timeouts in Python/Go and AbortController compatibility in TypeScript. - Fixes parity bugs found in previous releases: Python stream teardown race (leak), TS header propagation for delegated credentials, Go retry jitter math leading to repeated fast retries. - Bumps SDK versions to v1.84.0 and updates changelogs. Checklist: - [x] Python: unify auth chain, add token refresh callback tests, fix stream teardown race. - [x] TypeScript: add AbortController support, fix header propagation, update docs/snippets. - [x] Go: new RetryPolicy, fix jitter bug, add integration test against mock gateway. - [x] Update CHANGELOGs and package manifests for v1.84.0. - [x] Run full CI matrix and e2e smoke tests. Backward compatibility notes: - Defaults changed for retries (max_attempts increased from 3 to 5, backoff_base_ms from 100 to 150). These are conservative and intended to reduce transient errors; documented in release notes. - Streaming API adds a new unified event interface but provides compatibility shims in all languages; no user code should break but advanced consumers can opt-in to the new event types. Testing and QA: - Added unit and integration tests for all three SDKs; end-to-end streaming tests added to perf-canary harness. - Verified major client libraries against hosted sandbox and dedicated local mock gateway. Related work: References ENG-1842 (SDK parity initiative), ENG-1920 (streaming ergonomics RFC).

notes_on_changes: Python: streaming.Stream now returns a StreamHandle with .cancel() and yields UnifiedEvent objects (type alias maintained for backward compat).
TypeScript: streaming client accepts AbortSignal and exposes on('delta') helpers; old .onMessage kept as alias. Header propagation bug fixed in auth chain.
Go: RetryPolicy exposed in sdk options, default backoff and jitter corrected; stream context cancellation integrated.
release_notes: SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) v1.84.0: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics; improved default retry policy; streaming API ergonomics (AbortController/Context/cancel()); parity bug fixes across languages. See CHANGELOGs for migration notes.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Clients relying on previous retry defaults may see longer retry windows; Mitigation: documented defaults and added opt-out by explicitly setting RetryPolicy in client options. Streaming API provides compatibility aliases and migration doc.
